While the kids are away at class, Bhide revels in the rare peace and quiet in the society compound. Meanwhile, Daya misses Tapu’s energetic presence at home and suggests inviting Sundar to Mumbai to learn magic, which Jethalal immediately shoots down.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
